managed-tool-preparation.allow_configura: Allow this node to prepare tool configurations

Optional and off by default. First allow installed-tool detection. Only continuous startup receives this configuration-write permission; one-time reports and file preparation do not. Task execution still needs its separate existing permission.
managed-tool-preparation.title: Configure the detected tool
managed-tool-preparation.claude_model_hi: Explicitly choose the Claude CLI model for this configuration. The detected default is not adopted; this uses the node's existing CLI login and accepts no credential reference.
managed-tool-preparation.existing_config: Use the detected local tool configuration. This operation does not change its model or account.
managed-tool-preparation.codex_existing_: Pair this installation with the single Codex App Server configuration approved on this node. The node checks the model catalog during preparation.
managed-tool-preparation.codex_capabilit: This node has not confirmed Codex preparation. Ask the node administrator to review its approved configuration, or use the existing preparation guide.
managed-tool-preparation.codex_rescan_re: This scan belongs to an earlier maintenance session. Detect the installation again for the current node.
managed-tool-preparation.credential_opti: Qoder may use its existing local login. Leave the name empty to keep that mode; never paste a secret.
managed-tool-preparation.credential_requ: Enter the name of an allowed variable already present on this node, not its value.
managed-tool-preparation.acknowledge: Allow this node to write a new configuration for this detected tool. Keep existing tasks and configurations unchanged.
managed-tool-preparation.paused_only: This configuration is not available for tasks. You may save it paused; enabling still requires the original current checks.
managed-tool-preparation.configuration_r: Configuration reported; task execution is unavailable
managed-tool-preparation.capability_unav: This node has not currently confirmed configuration-write support. Refresh its status or use the existing preparation guide.
managed-tool-preparation.configuration_a: The node accepted the new configuration. Inventory confirmation and tool availability are separate facts.
managed-tool-preparation.source_changed: The original source has changed. Retain this operation for reconciliation; do not repeat the write with a new key.
managed-tool-preparation.wait_finished: Automatic waiting has ended. Read the same operation again; no new configuration will be written.
managed-tool-preparation.boundary: The node accepts the new configuration and reports its inventory. You can then save it paused. Enablement and task dispatch require separate confirmation.
managed-tool-preparation.invalid_respons: The configuration response does not match the current scope or complete receipt.
managed-tool-preparation.inventory_chang: Current inventory no longer confirms the exact accepted configuration. Read the status again and explicitly select a current configuration.
managed-tool-preparation.pin_changed: The selected configuration or observation has changed. Explicitly choose the current configuration before saving it.
managed-tool-preparation.state.configure: Review the tool configuration and confirm this write.
managed-tool-preparation.state.pending: Configuration requested; waiting for this exact node.
managed-tool-preparation.state.claimed: The node is preparing this configuration.
managed-tool-preparation.state.awaiting_: Configuration accepted; waiting for the original inventory acknowledgement.
managed-tool-preparation.state.completed: The accepted configuration has a confirmed inventory receipt. Continue with a fresh read before paused registration.
managed-tool-preparation.state.failed: Preparation did not complete. Check the recorded reason.
managed-tool-preparation.state.unknown: The original outcome is unknown. Reconcile this request; do not start another write.
managed-tool-preparation.state.closed_un: The original outcome remains unknown, and its maintenance occupation has been safely closed. This is not a rollback or availability claim.
managed-tool-preparation.state.expired: This request expired before it was claimed.
managed-tool-preparation.state.supersede: The original source changed before preparation began.
managed-tool-preparation.state.write_unk: The browser has not confirmed the write acknowledgement. Check the same request and key.
managed-tool-preparation.state.forbidden: Current access could not be confirmed. Read the status again after access is restored.
managed-tool-preparation.result.not_star: The node did not begin preparation.
managed-tool-preparation.result.rescan_r: The node no longer has the original private scan receipt. Explicitly detect the installation again after this operation is settled.
managed-tool-preparation.result.credenti: The named environment reference is unavailable on this node. Configure that name on the node; do not paste its value here.
managed-tool-preparation.result.native_s: The original executable or its pinned resources changed.
managed-tool-preparation.result.generati: The node now has a different configuration generation.
managed-tool-preparation.result.preparat: This node does not currently support this preparation.
The node could not accept the new configuration.
The preparation lease ended without a confirmed result.
Preparation was interrupted; the original outcome is unknown.
managed-tool-preparation.result.worker_r: The node restarted before the original outcome was confirmed.
managed-tool-preparation.result.outcome_: The original configuration outcome is unknown.
managed-tool-preparation.result.prepared: The node accepted the configuration; inventory acknowledgement is still pending.
managed-tool-preparation.result.complete: The exact configuration inventory acknowledgement was recorded.
